summary: Sarah Michelle Gellar criticised Roblox on Instagram after her son's account was allegedly hacked, leading her to cancel her credit card and see her iCloud account disabled. Roblox said it was looking into the case and pointed to its parental tools, while social media users reacted with jokes and criticism. The article also recalls Kim Kardashian's 2022 clash with Roblox over a minigame referencing her sex tape.
one_line: Sarah Michelle Gellar blasted Roblox's parental controls after her son's account was allegedly hacked, echoing Kim Kardashian's earlier dispute with the platform.
key_facts: Sarah Michelle Gellar, 46, posted on Instagram on 4 December about her son's Roblox account being allegedly hacked.
Gellar shares son Rocky, 11, and daughter Charlotte Grace, 14, with husband Freddie Prinze Jr.
Her screenshot showed an iPhone notification that her iCloud account 'has been disabled' in the App Store and iTunes.
Gellar wrote that she had to cancel her credit card and 'now my life is basically cancelled', and asked Roblox 'Why don't you have better parental help?!?'
Roblox is free to download on Android, iOS, Xbox and Windows, but players can spend money on in-game items and customisations.
According to TechCrunch, Roblox users range from ages eight to 18, with a key demographic of nine to 15.
One X user called it 'the most important beef of 2023', and another joked 'Buffy vs Roblox' was where Millennial vs Gen Z discourse was heading.
One user questioned why parents let children use their credit cards on games.
A Roblox spokesperson told The Independent the company was looking into the case, had reached out to the user, and offers a Parent & Caregiver Guide and 24/7 support.
In the season one premiere of The Kardashians, Kim Kardashian's son Saint, eight, found a Roblox minigame registered under the username 'KimsNewSexTape'.
Kardashian said she planned on 'suing' Roblox and had 'all the time, all the money, and all of the resources' to fight it.
According to Polygon, the minigame's developer was reportedly banned when the episode aired in April 2022.
Roblox said the referenced video was never available on its platform and the text reference that evaded its filters was quickly taken down.
